body_html: BEST SHOW EVER!!!!! Man, it, really feels good to have my own equipment! I got to break it in!! We had a FLAWLESS SHOW! Thank you to my friends for coming down and JAMMIN with me!!!! BLAKE ST. TAVERN was so busy there was ALWAYS SOMEONE ON THE DANCE FLOOR!! I had some OFF THE WALL REQUESTS, but I ACCOMMODATED EVERYONE!! End result, constant BOOTY SHAKING!!! The BLAKE ST. staff was even DANCING BEHIND THE BAR! WE WERE JAMMIN SO HARD, next thing I know, the lights came on and it was time to go home! I couldn’t believe it, I didn’t want to STOP!!       P.S. Thanks Meg for allowing one more song , you’re a frickin ROCKSTAR!
